about_the_game:
Set up camp deep in the heart of the jungle and get ready for a true adventure!
Explore forgotten ruins, collect ancient artifacts, upgrade your gear, and expand your expedition camp.
In Jungle Jinx, you choose your path: dodge deadly traps, battle enemies, or race through wild jungle tracks in chaotic kart runs!

Your base and control center for all adventures.
Upgrade buildings, enhance weapons, trade with merchants, and manage your expedition.
Level up your character’s stats: strength, speed, stamina, and inventory size.
Unlock new zones, game modes, and hidden secrets on the world map!

Escape from a massive rolling boulder and survive deadly jungle traps to carry the artifact to safety.
At launch, three unique locations await you — each with their own enemies and challenges:

  • Tomb — an ancient crypt filled with spikes and shifting walls

  • Halls — temple corridors packed with moving traps and lethal darts

  • Cave — damp caverns with breakable platforms and venomous creatures

Each zone demands new strategies, quick reflexes, and full concentration. The deeper you go — the more dangerous it gets!

Fight off waves of enemies using weapons, tactical positioning, and unique abilities.
Gold, resources, and glory await only the strongest!

Race through the jungle in high-speed chaos with boosts, traps, and arcade-style madness inspired!
This mode will be added in a future update.

✨ Collect Amulets

Jungle Jinx is full of magic and challenges!
Find and use powerful amulets to overcome obstacles or crush your enemies:

  • Air Amulet — create platforms in mid-air to leap over traps and chasms

  • Ghost Amulet — shift into an astral state to pass through projectiles unharmed

  • Summoning Amulet — loot flies straight into your backpack

  • Shield Amulet — block incoming damage from traps and projectiles (limited time)

  • Power Amulet — smash enemies and open chests with a single dash

🗡 Upgrade Your Weapons

Increase weapon durability and enhance magical properties using crystals.
Unlock powerful effects and combat abilities.

🧱 Interact with the Environment

  • Break pots to find coins and loot

  • Blow up barrels to defeat enemies

  • Light fuses, sharpen your blade mid-fight

  • Open chests or freeze time to bypass tricky traps

🧍 Character Progression

Customize your hero’s appearance and upgrade their stats to take on tougher challenges:
Strength, speed, stamina, special techniques, and inventory capacity.

🏕️ Camp Development

Build and upgrade your camp to unlock even more possibilities:
Workshops, merchants, unique areas, and new features for battle and exploration.

🧭 Jungle Secrets

Explore the vast world of Jungle Jinx to discover rare relics, artifacts, and hidden treasures.

🎨 Art Style

A bright and memorable visual style that blends fast-paced arcade action with the spirit of adventure.

🏆 Collect artifacts. Defeat enemies. Build your camp.

Become a legend of the Jungle Jinx expedition!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 / 8 / 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2nd Gen) or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or higher
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 or higher
  • Storage: 20 MB available space
